{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or shows recent pessimism (e.g., sentiment < 0.00).",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude when recent history shows mean reversion toward lower prices (e.g., 3-5 consecutive days of declining prices).",
    "Increase forecast slightly after a sharp price spike if sentiment is neutral or mildly positive (e.g., sentiment > 0.00) to avoid undershooting.",
    "Apply a lag correction: if true outcome is significantly lower than forecast, adjust next forecast downward by 5-10% to account for delayed market reaction.",
    "Avoid over-optimism in forecasts when sentiment is mixed or volatile (e.g., sentiment fluctuating between 0.00 and 0.50).",
    "If sentiment is positive and forecast is consistently below true outcome, increase forecast by 5-10% to capture sentiment-driven momentum.",
    "For long-term horizons (>10 days), apply a smoothing filter to reduce volatility and avoid overreaction to short-term sentiment shifts."
  ]
}
